option_relations.rationale: Extramedullary plasmacytoma does not match the provided pathological analysis and imaging studies.
Non-Hodgkin lymphoma, not otherwise specified, is too broad and does not match the specific pathological findings.
Primary extramedullary plasmacytoma does not match the provided pathological analysis and imaging studies.
Plasmablastic lymphoma (PBL) matches the pathological analysis, including CD138-positive, CD56-positive, and EBV-positive, as well as the imaging studies.
